# `vector_avg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
vector_avg(array)
```

Returns the element-wise mean of float vectors in a group.
All vectors must have the same dimension.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `vector_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- vector_avg, example 1
> SELECT vector_avg(col) FROM VALUES (array(1.0F, 2.0F)), (array(3.0F, 4.0F)) AS tab(col);
[2.0,3.0]
```
